description: SQID implementation made specifically for ASP.NET Core usage

Jakar.Json for HttpClient: JakarJsonContent and GetFromJakarJsonAsync / PostAsJakarJsonAsync / PutAsJakarJsonAsync / PatchAsJakarJsonAsync / ReadFromJakarJsonAsync, in the shape of System.Net.Http.Json, streaming [JsonModel] types with no reflection.

Jakar.Json inside System.Text.Json: a JsonConverterFactory that reads and writes [JsonModel] types (and collections of them) with Jakar.Json wherever System.Text.Json is configured - SignalR, Blazor, HttpClient, Npgsql, Dapr, Azure SDKs, Microsoft.Extensions.AI and more.
Jakar.Json as an Akka.NET serializer: messages and persisted events of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json, bound by configuration or SerializationSetup.

Jakar.Json as an AWS Lambda serializer: [JsonModel] requests and responses are read and written by Jakar.Json (reflection-free, Native AOT friendly); other types (AWS event types) go to a fallback serializer.

Jakar.Json as an Azure SDK ObjectSerializer (Azure.Core): [JsonModel] types are read and written by Jakar.Json in Azure Search, Functions (isolated worker), Event Grid, Service Bus / Event Hubs payloads and every SDK that takes an ObjectSerializer; other types go to a fallback.
Native openSeaChest binaries for storage device diagnostics and management.

Jakar.Json for Microsoft's caches: a HybridCache serializer factory for [JsonModel] types (other types keep HybridCache's default), and IDistributedCache helpers that store models as Jakar.Json UTF-8 (zero-copy with IBufferDistributedCache).
Jakar.Json for CAP (DotNetCore.CAP): message payloads of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json through CAP's System.Text.Json serializer.

Jakar.Json as the Azure Cosmos DB serializer: items of [JsonModel] types (and collections of them) are read and written by Jakar.Json; other types go to a System.Text.Json fallback, which also names members for LINQ queries.
Jakar.Json for Dapper: type handlers that write [JsonModel] parameters (and collections of them) as Jakar.Json text and read JSON columns back into models, for any ADO.NET provider.

Jakar.Json as the Durable Task (Durable Functions / Durable Task Scheduler) data converter: orchestration and activity inputs and outputs of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json; other types go to a fallback.
Jakar.Json as the EasyNetQ (RabbitMQ) message serializer: [JsonModel] messages are written into pooled buffers EasyNetQ owns and read straight from the delivery; other types go to a fallback.

Jakar.Json as the Elasticsearch .NET client's source serializer: documents (_source) of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json; other types go to the client's default System.Text.Json source serializer.

Jakar.Json for EF Core JSON columns: a value converter and value comparer that store [JsonModel] properties (and collections of them) as Jakar.Json text, for any provider (PostgreSQL jsonb, SQL Server, SQLite, ...).

Jakar.Json as Flurl.Http's JSON serializer: request and response bodies of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json (responses from the stream); other types go to Flurl's System.Text.Json serializer.

Jakar.Json as FusionCache's distributed-cache serializer: [JsonModel] values (and collections of them) are written by Jakar.Json, common scalars in binary, inside a compact binary entry envelope. Other types can go to a fallback serializer. Reflection-free under Native AOT.
Jakar.Json for GraphQL.Client: response data (and variables) of [JsonModel] types are read and written by Jakar.Json through the client's System.Text.Json serializer, over HTTP and WebSockets.
Jakar.Json for Confluent.Kafka: serializers and deserializers (sync and async) for [JsonModel] keys and values, and producer/consumer builder extensions.
A JSON console formatter for Microsoft.Extensions.Logging that writes [JsonModel] values in log state and scopes as structured JSON (by Jakar.Json) instead of ToString().
Jakar.Json for Marten (PostgreSQL document database and event store): documents and events of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json through Marten's System.Text.Json serializer.

Jakar.Json for MassTransit: messages of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json inside MassTransit's JSON envelope (the System.Text.Json serializer, configured with Jakar.Json.SystemTextJson).
Jakar.Json for NServiceBus: messages of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json through NServiceBus' System.Text.Json serializer.

OpenAPI schemas that match Jakar.Json: [JsonModel] types are described with the property names Jakar.Json writes ([JsonModel] naming, [JsonMember], System.Text.Json attributes), for Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi (schema transformer) and Swashbuckle (data contract resolver).
Jakar.Json as the OpenSearch .NET client's source serializer: documents (_source) of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json; other types go to the client's built-in serializer.

Jakar.Json for Orleans: grain call arguments, results and state of [JsonModel] types are serialized by Jakar.Json inside Orleans' serializer (its System.Text.Json codec, for exactly the types Jakar.Json supports).
Jakar.Json for Quartz.NET job data: store [JsonModel] values in a JobDataMap as Jakar.Json text and read them back - what Quartz' persistent stores require for structured values, with any serializer.
Jakar.Json for Rebus: message bodies of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json inside Rebus' System.Text.Json serializer (configured with Jakar.Json.SystemTextJson).

Jakar.Json as Refit's content serializer: request and response bodies of [JsonModel] types (and collections of them) are written and read by Jakar.Json; other types go to a fallback (Refit's System.Text.Json serializer by default).

Jakar.Json as RestSharp's serializer: request and response bodies of [JsonModel] types (and collections of them) are written and read by Jakar.Json, responses straight from their bytes; other types go to a fallback (RestSharp's System.Text.Json serializer by default).
Jakar.Json for Serilog: [JsonModel] values logged with {@Value} are destructured with the names and shape Jakar.Json writes them in, instead of by reflection.
Jakar.Json for SignalR's JSON hub protocol: hub method arguments and results of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json, on servers and .NET clients alike.
Jakar.Json for StackExchange.Redis: store and read [JsonModel] values in Redis strings and hashes as Jakar.Json UTF-8, written from pooled buffers and read from pooled leases.

Jakar.Json for Temporal (.NET SDK): workflow and activity arguments and results of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json as json/plain payloads; other values keep Temporal's converters.

Jakar.Json as Wolverine's message serializer: messages of [JsonModel] types are written and read by Jakar.Json, straight from the envelope body; other types go to Wolverine's System.Text.Json serializer.
A process-based utility for openSeaChest storage device diagnostics and management.
Read and write the lot architecture of Maxis' The Sims 4: walls, floors, roofs, stairs, terrain and the rest of a lot's build, in world files, save games and tray blueprints.
